tasks.title: Delivery contract and provisional-policy decision
tasks.work: Freeze usable output, two contrast scenarios, fallback ladder and bounded V3 prototype scope. Pin candidate runtime and interface; a manifest is sufficient.
tasks.exit: Owner accepts bounded prototype policy and eight-case evaluation contract; engineering can implement without repeated method permission requests.
tasks.hostile: Policy ambiguity cannot create observed facts; source access and actual trust requirements remain operation-local.

tasks.title: Pin and run the inherited developmental baseline
tasks.work: Compare adjudicated archive against local V3/V2 manifest; select one baseline; run its permitted isolated source-free smoke path.
tasks.exit: One replayable actor history and state-backed expression, even with declared broad priors; exact blocker repair if run fails.
tasks.hostile: No first-candidate bypass, unlogged randomness, invented diagnosis or renderer mutation.

tasks.title: Bind useful retained inputs to a world/possibility snapshot
tasks.timebox: One focused session in parallel with T01
tasks.work: Reuse M1–M4, rich C1 and P04 seams; carry selected release, context, joints, uncertainty and evidence modes to a concrete developmental input.
tasks.exit: Saved snapshot plus receipt proves consumer reads values, not just context IDs. One genuine retained empirical dependency plus explicit model fallbacks.
tasks.hostile: False joint, wrong population, denominator loss, ignored world payload, CURRENT claim on frozen snapshot.

tasks.title: Deliver the first evaluated person loop
tasks.timebox: Target 3–5 focused engineering days from issuance, contingent on baseline smoke test
tasks.work: Wire snapshot→developmental transitions→state→expression. Deliver 16 seeded cases across matched contrasts, browseable biography and evidence trace.
tasks.exit: Eight-case suite in 02/06 passes at prototype scope; user can inspect and compare real outputs. Report failures and ship the honest simpler mode.
tasks.hostile: A generic biography pasted over unchanged state, deterministic stereotypes, empirical labels on priors or fabricated childhood facts.

tasks.title: Improve only the weak methods exposed by the loop
tasks.timebox: One method decision per focused session
tasks.work: Compare baseline against at most one stronger candidate per gap: pooling, temporal smoothing or proxy/latent mapping. Keep same inputs/consumer.
tasks.exit: Demonstrated product/calibration benefit or explicit no-replacement decision; deploy simpler fallback if inconclusive.
tasks.hostile: Training-test leakage, minority erasure, spurious certainty and higher cost without downstream benefit.

tasks.title: Integrate original-work automation and omission oracle
tasks.owner_role: Empirical integration and independent expected-work owners
tasks.work: Reuse P01/P05 constructors, freeze original U/E before execution, integrate exact candidate delta and bind first lawful real slice.
tasks.exit: Original→expected→declared→durable result→actual consumer receipt; positive omission adversary fails.
tasks.hostile: Output-derived expected set, held item silently dropped, directional/J-only omissions, inconsistent recovery.

tasks.title: Close invoked release and recovery trust gaps
tasks.timebox: Parallel; prerequisite only for invoked protected mode
tasks.work: Preserve N04 correction; test P02R/N04R remaining history, wrapper and external-root gaps on exact selected path.
tasks.exit: Declared trust promise proved for exact modes; current/as-of effects and affected descendants correct.
tasks.hostile: Self-consistent forged history, revocation bypass, unwrapped CURRENT access, false independent root.

tasks.title: Expand generalized source and operation coverage
tasks.owner_role: Source/design owners and empirical production engineer
tasks.work: Keep all 35 sources and finite issued operation frontiers; prioritize product demand then remaining functions. Use generic contracts, not bespoke selected-question scripts.
tasks.exit: Per-source original/operation/consumer reconciliation, typed holds and no silent loss. Full35 remains separate exit.
tasks.hostile: False N/A, skipped battery child, raw design fabrication, suppressed low-frequency branch, partial frontier called complete.

tasks.title: Complete useful institutional and temporal channels
tasks.timebox: Parallel to T03 and source lane
tasks.work: Reuse V553→V558 and actual external field contracts. Select material/history gaps exposed by person scenarios; Ghana optional validation.
tasks.exit: Changed historical/material evidence produces appropriate context differences and traceable modeled uncertainty.
tasks.hostile: Ratification equals enforcement, repeated cross-sections equal individual transition, time extrapolation labeled measured.

tasks.title: Qualify richer product and independent release
tasks.work: Assess source transfer, minority configurations, cohort effects, parent priors, replay and narrative fidelity; use live outputs.
tasks.exit: Scoped release passes declared acceptance; limitations recorded alongside concrete generated persons.
tasks.hostile: Pretty prose conceals invariant state or unsupported confidence; reviewer merely repeats author oracle.

tasks.title: Full PRE-V3 estate certificate
tasks.work: Conserve F1–F8, AT01–AT35, exact35 and Long Memory function debts; complete original operations and terminal consumers.
tasks.exit: Independent exact full-estate certificate; no fixture/global test multiplied across waves.
tasks.hostile: Counts substitute for products; unreached telemetry invented; narrower prototype declared full completion.

tasks.title: Full production activation decision
tasks.owner_role: Project owner and competent release authority
tasks.work: Review full certificate, product evidence, runtime custody and support/recovery plan.
tasks.exit: Explicit full-production activation decision; bounded prototype approval is not automatically full activation.
tasks.hostile: Silent scope escalation from prototype, stale exact candidate or self-adoption.
